tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: The brand ground. Default background of a post; also the arrow glyph on a forest CTA bar.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Headlines, mono labels and outlines on olive, cream and paper; fill of the CTA bar and sticker tags.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Second ground and card fill. Text on forest fills (CTA bar, sticker tags).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Lightest ground for long reads (quotes, tips). Use with forest ink.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Index numbers (01, 02…) on cream list cards. Secondary only: 3.8:1 on cream, so keep it at 24px or larger.

tokens.name: olive-faded
tokens.usage: Struck-through or 'deleted' words on olive (e.g. ИЗБРИШАНИ). Deliberately low contrast (2.7:1): never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Raised forest surfaces (a second block on a forest post) and pattern ink on forest grounds.

tokens.name: olive-light
tokens.usage: Relief tint: highlighter marks behind words, pattern ink on olive at low opacity, sticker variants.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Only for the 'without a system' side of a comparison (❌ rows). Never a ground for a whole post.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The post background for the active preset.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, labels and outlines on `ground`. 6.4:1 on olive, 13.9:1 on cream and forest.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cards, sticker fills and arrows. On cream, olive is decorative only (2.2:1): never set body text in it.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Fill of the CTA bar and progress bar.

tokens.name: on-bar
tokens.usage: Text on `bar`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Main headline on a 1080px post. Uppercase, two to three lines.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Headline when a list or cards share the post.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Page titles in the generator app.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: All app text. Never smaller than 18px.

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every side of a 1080px post. Nothing but bleeding patterns and photos crosses it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside the progress bar frame (bar to outline).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between list cards; chip gutters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a mono label and the headline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between headline and content block.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between content block and CTA bar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, chips, bars and stickers are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only polka dots and the circular stamp sticker.

tokens.name: border-chip
tokens.usage: Outline of chips and outline-headline stroke width.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: Outline of the progress bar frame.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tilted list cards and sticker tags only.
